_comment: The application commit this workflow is approved to deploy.
A 40-hex app_sha input establishes SYNTAX, not approval. Every commit on
every branch is 40 hex characters. This file is the approval, it lives on
the default branch, and changing it is a reviewed change.
The candidate checkout never supplies its own approval: this file is read
from the operational checkout (the commit the workflow itself ran from),
never from the application commit under deployment.
Future acceptances are a one-line edit here, reviewed like any other.
packageLabel: FIVE ACCEPTED MEMBER PAGES, THE ACCEPTED IDENTITY FUNNEL, THE ACCEPTED INVITATION, KIOSK CONFINEMENT AND THE HOME COMMUNITY-LIST VIEW. Home, MOVE/contribution, Community, Progress and You carry the accepted visual-reset member experience; /signin, /signup, /reset-password, /verify-email and /profile-setup carry Batch A identity and onboarding; /join/[joinCode] carries the accepted invitation (final page acceptance at a760a4e, PR #417). NEW IN THIS PIN: kiosk confinement (PR #427 at 6690370, integrated as 7ba768e) - on a shared device the tab bar and the contribution screen offer no way into the visitor's own account, and the unresolved-contribution notice says the contribution can be confirmed here before finishing and that entering it again elsewhere could count it twice, instead of promising portability; and /?view=communities (PR #432 at de8f567, integrated as c8f38e3) - one navigation asks Home to show the community list instead of opening the resolved community. KIOSK HOLD UNCHANGED: shared and unattended kiosk use remains HELD by the owner; source and pixel acceptance of the confinement change does not clear that hold, and this pin does not claim it does. Also carried unchanged: the contribution screen keeps its scroll view out from under the raised MOVE action on short phones (PR #400); the Join TARGET rebaseline (PR #420) touches only the design-target reference component. ON VERIFICATION: unchanged from the previous pin - where email is unconfigured /verify-email offers no manual check and no resend and refreshes auth state itself, bounded and account-isolated. EMAIL DELIVERY BLOCKED AT RUNTIME; SIGNUP SMOKE INCOMPLETE: the sender and secret version are established by run 44 and the mail-binding metadata, and the observed sends fail during Admin Auth link generation before the provider, so a real signup cannot complete on this staging until the runtime permission is reconciled by the operator. Frontend only: no function code, no rules, no indexes, no IAM and no mail configuration. No #390 member-visibility content, no responsive public display (PR #435), no Start Community page, no goal-target setup and no privacy work.

_uiOnlyPromotionNote: c8f38e37b6286297d1f401834cd9500a675a2923 is measured against d0477cc047f4e71133fed0741935ebb99d46024d, the SHA this file previously approved and which staging serves (run 35799508497, deploy success, hosted marker matched). d0477cc is an ancestor of the candidate. Re-derived for this pin rather than carried over: functions-westayfit/, .github/, functions/, apps/goarrive/ and scripts/westayfit/ are IDENTICAL tree objects, and firestore.rules, firestore.indexes.json, firebase.json, firebase.westayfit.json, firebase.westayfit.emulators.json, .firebaserc, package.json, package-lock.json, apps/westayfit/package.json and apps/westayfit/app.json are IDENTICAL blobs. The two scripts this workflow executes, scripts/westayfit/build-staging.sh and scripts/westayfit/assert-staging-artifact.sh, are byte-identical across the range (an earlier check that looked for them at the repository root reported a difference; they live under scripts/westayfit/ in both trees and are the same blobs). The delta is 29 files: member application source under apps/westayfit/app (2 files: contribute/[goalId], index) and apps/westayfit/src (2 files: kioskSession, ui/MemberTabBar), one design-target reference component (src/ui/designTarget/JoinSetupTargets, reachable only through the design-target route), 2 end-to-end specs, 1 unit test, and 21 documentation and capture-evidence files under docs/. The range is three first-parent merges on the app-shell branch: a193b43 (PR #420, Join TARGET rebaseline), 7ba768e (PR #427 at 6690370, kiosk confinement, independently verified twice on PR #395 and pixel-passed) and c8f38e3 (PR #432 at de8f567, /?view=communities, independently verified on PR #434). expectedPriorFunctions stays 46 for the same reason as the previous four pins: the functions tree is unchanged from the SHA already deployed, so this deploy must create nothing. The focused candidate check on this exact SHA is delegated to the independent QA worker (PR #395) and is recorded there; this file records the boundary, not that result.
_twelveTransportNote: SUPERSEDED READING, CORRECTED HERE. An earlier version of this note said twelve services (wsfeventcontext, wsfjointurnline, wsfturnready, wsfmyturn, wsfcompletemyturn, wsfleaveturnline, wsfcreatecombinedgoal, wsfclosecombinedgoal, wsfrepaircombinedgoal, wsfapprovestation, wsfliststations, wsfrevokestation) remained invoker_iam_check_enabled, citing run 35450108207, and concluded the expo queue path was unusable. That is WRONG as of the later run 35474881609 (run 32, 2026-09-19T23:06:35Z), whose verify receipt reads every one of those twelve as invoker_iam_check_disabled, alongside PREEXISTING_TRANSPORT_VERIFIED=22/22, NEW_SERVICE_TRANSPORT=invoker_iam_check_disabled and VERIFY=pass. The transports are open. Read from that run's own log, not carried over from a review. WHAT RUN 32 ALSO EXERCISED, which is a separate and stronger fact than transport: eight of those twelve answered at the application level in its 24-PASS turn row, called with synthetic members' own Firebase ID tokens - wsfEventContext, wsfJoinTurnLine, wsfLeaveTurnLine, wsfMyTurn, wsfTurnReady, wsfCompleteMyTurn, wsfCreateCombinedGoal and wsfApproveStation. THE OTHER FOUR ARE TRANSPORT-OPEN BUT UNEXERCISED: wsfCloseCombinedGoal, wsfRepairCombinedGoal, wsfListStations and wsfRevokeStation are not called by hosted-package-e-smoke.mjs at all, so no hosted run has established how they answer. SCOPE, AND THE LINE THIS NOTE MUST NOT CROSS: service-level acceptance is not the browser/player journey. It does not establish QR to retained activity/auth to phone-or-queue choice to ready/start to shared player to review/receipt to cleared station. That gate remains pending until 6b257c3 is actually served and one hosted player run passes. Nothing in this pin changes any transport, IAM binding or function code.
